title: Bringing Salesforce to Copilot as we build Copilot as the OS for work!
summary: Bringing Salesforce to Copilot as we build Copilot as the OS for work! | 272 comments on LinkedIn
body_markdown: Introducing Copilotforce Salesforce customer context and sales workflows are coming to[Microsoft Copilot](https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/microsoftcopilot/?trk=public_post_reshare-text) and Teams—where more than 400M people already collaborate Our expanded partnership with[Microsoft](https://www.linkedin.com/company/microsoft?trk=public_post_reshare-text) spans Copilot, Teams & Fabric: → Salesforce in Microsoft Copilot will help sellers prepare for meetings, spot deal risks & take supported Salesforce actions, informed by customer context, emails, meetings & shared documents →[Sales Cloud](https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/salesforcesalescloud/?trk=public_post_reshare-text) in Teams will bring pipeline insights, deal alerts & supported opportunity updates into Teams, with Agentforce Coworker helping sellers delegate work & take action →[Salesforce Data 360](https://www.linkedin.com/showcase/sfdc-data-360/?trk=public_post_reshare-text) + Microsoft Fabric connect through bidirectional zero copy, so teams can access data across both platforms without duplicating source datasets →[Informatica](https://www.linkedin.com/company/informatica?trk=public_post_reshare-text) expands its Microsoft integrations to help teams find trusted data in Copilot, build governed AI agents in Foundry & trace data lineage in Fabric[Accenture](https://ie.linkedin.com/company/accenture?trk=public_post_reshare-text) joins as Customer Zero and design and implementation partner to help shape and validate Copilotforce within its global sales organization, after scaling Microsoft Copilot to 740,000+ people See what’s new from[#MSIgnite](https://www.linkedin.com/signup/cold-join?session_redirect=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.linkedin.com%2Ffeed%2Fhashtag%2Fmsignite&trk=public_post_reshare-text) :[https://sforce.co/4C90lqk](https://sforce.co/4C90lqk?trk=public_post_reshare-text)
